But they run opposite on openness: Alexander's language is deliberately open-ended, generative, endlessly recombinable; the Registry Pattern deliberately closes the vocabulary to prevent hallucination. Genuinely contestable whether this is closer to a mirror or a contradiction, so connects-to with a label rather than forcing a type.
